patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-fashion photography is used as the dominant background for most content sections, creating an immersive visual experience that prioritizes imagery.
Extreme scale typography is used for hero text and section titles, often overlapping imagery and serving as a primary visual element rather than just informational text.
A high-contrast palette of black and white is consistently used for text and structural elements, with vibrant accent colors derived directly from the full-bleed photography.
Hero text elements parallax against their background images, moving at a slower rate than the scroll to create a subtle depth effect.

The main navigation bar at the top transforms from a transparent background with white text to a solid white background with black text as the user scrolls past the initial hero section, becoming sticky.
Typographic hero sections feature extremely large, light-colored text overlaid on full-bleed imagery, establishing a bold, editorial tone immediately.

technique_notes: Full-bleed, high-resolution photography is used as background for most content sections, creating an immersive visual experience that feels like a fashion magazine spread.
A sticky header navigation bar transitions its background from transparent to solid white and changes text color from white to black upon scrolling past the initial hero section.
Hero text elements are designed to parallax, moving at a slower rate than the scroll, creating a depth effect against the background image, likely using GSAP or Locomotive Scroll for precise control.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~8x body) with smaller, lighter sans-serif body and navigation text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used across all elements, including buttons and input fields, reinforcing a clean, modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in hero and large typographic sections, creating a sense of grandeur, while footer links are more densely packed for information density.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, almost extreme use of typography, where section titles and hero text are scaled to monumental proportions, often overlapping full-bleed, high-fashion photography. This creates an editorial, magazine-like aesthetic that feels more like a visual art piece than a typical e-commerce site, emphasizing brand identity and visual impact.
